title: Shell and Exxon Mull Infineum Sale
summary: Shell and ExxonMobil are exploring a sale of Infineum, their 50-50 lubricant and fuel additives joint venture, in a deal that could value the business at about U.S. $8 billion, according to press reports. The owners have appointed Bank of America to advise on the process, which remains at an early stage and may not lead to a transaction, according to people familiar with the matter.
